recall.uz: Podsho va dono kishi haqidagi rivoyatni tinglab oʻqiymiz, voqealar tartibini topamiz va kitob nega kuchli ekanini bilib olamiz.
recall.ru: Слушаем предание о царе и мудреце, находим порядок событий и узнаём, почему книга сильна.
recall.en: We read a tale about a king and a wise man, put the events in order, and learn why a book is powerful.

props.title: Kitob — dono maslahatchi
lines: Qadim zamonda bir podsho yashagan ekan.
Vazirlar oʻylanib qolibdi — biri oltin, biri qilich debdi.
Shunda qoʻshni yurtdan bir dono kishini topib kelishibdi.
«Eng kuchli narsa — kitob, chunki u bilim beradi.

prompt.ru: Послушай и читай предание, следя за текстом!
prompt.en: Listen and follow along as you read the tale!

hint.uz: Dono kishi eng kuchli narsa deb nimani aytdi?
hint.en: What did the wise man call the most powerful thing?

explanation.uz: Rivoyatda kitob — bilim bergani uchun eng kuchli narsa deb koʻrsatiladi.
explanation.ru: В предании книга — самое сильное, ведь она даёт знания.
explanation.en: In the tale, a book is the most powerful thing because it gives knowledge.

prompt.uz: Topishmoq: tili yoʻq, ammo dunyoni oʻrgatadi; javonda turadi, varaqlanadi. Bu nima?
prompt.ru: Загадка: без языка, а миру учит; стоит на полке, её листают. Что это?
prompt.en: Riddle: it has no tongue yet teaches the world; it sits on a shelf and you turn its pages. What is it?

hint.en: You read it and gain knowledge from it.

explanation.uz: Bu — kitob: u gapirmaydi, lekin bilim beradi.
explanation.ru: Это книга: она молчит, но даёт знания.
explanation.en: It's a book: silent, yet it gives knowledge.

text.uz: Podsho vazirlaridan eng kuchli narsa nima deb soʻrabdi.
text.ru: Царь спросил визирей, что самое сильное.
text.en: The king asked his viziers what is the most powerful thing.

text.ru: Царю не понравился ни один ответ.
text.en: The king liked none of the answers.

text.uz: Qoʻshni yurtdan dono kishini topib kelishibdi.
text.en: They brought a wise man from a neighbouring land.
The wise man said, “The most powerful thing is a book.”

prompt.ru: Нажимай события в порядке, как они произошли!
prompt.en: Tap the events in the order they happened!

hint.en: First the king asked a question…

explanation.uz: Savol → turli javoblar → podsho norozi → dono kishi → «kitob» javobi.
explanation.ru: Вопрос → разные ответы → царь недоволен → мудрец → ответ «книга».
explanation.en: Question → different answers → king unhappy → wise man → the answer “a book”.

statement.uz: Dono kishi eng kuchli narsa — kitob, dedi.
statement.ru: Мудрец сказал, что самое сильное — книга.
statement.en: The wise man said the most powerful thing is a book.

why.uz: Matnda dono kishining aynan shu javobi keltirilgan.
why.ru: В тексте приведён именно этот ответ мудреца.
why.en: The text gives exactly this answer from the wise man.

prompt.en: According to the text, what is this statement?

explanation.uz: Toʻgʻri: dono kishi «eng kuchlisi — kitob» dedi.
explanation.en: True: the wise man said “the most powerful is a book.”

openEnd.uz: Seningcha, dunyodagi eng kuchli narsa nima? Nega?
openEnd.ru: Как ты думаешь, что самое сильное в мире? Почему?
openEnd.en: What do you think is the most powerful thing in the world? Why?

statement.en: The king gave the viziers gold.

why.ru: В предании об этом ничего не сказано.
why.en: The tale says nothing about this.

prompt.en: According to the text, what is this statement?

explanation.uz: «Matnda yoʻq»: sovgʻa haqida hech narsa aytilmagan.

before.uz: Vazirlar podshoning savoliga yaxshi javob bera olmadi.
before.ru: Визири не смогли хорошо ответить царю.
before.en: The viziers couldn't answer the king well.

text.uz: Qoʻshni yurtdan dono kishini izlab topishdi.
text.en: They found a wise man from a neighbouring land.

prompt.uz: Vazirlar javob topa olmagach, nima roʻy berdi?
prompt.ru: Что произошло, когда визири не нашли ответа?
prompt.en: What happened when the viziers had no answer?

hint.en: Where did they find the wise man?

explanation.uz: Vazirlar qoʻshni yurtdan dono kishini topib kelishdi.
explanation.ru: Визири привели мудреца из соседней страны.
explanation.en: The viziers brought a wise man from a neighbouring land.

prompt.en: Match each word to its meaning!

explanation.uz: donishmand = dono kishi; rivoyat = hikoya; taraddudsiz = ikkilanmay.
explanation.ru: donishmand = мудрец; rivoyat = предание; taraddudsiz = без колебаний.
explanation.en: donishmand = a sage; rivoyat = a tale; taraddudsiz = without hesitation.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence with the right word!

hint.en: What does a book give us?

explanation.uz: Eng kuchli narsa — bilim; kitob esa bilim beradi.
explanation.ru: Самое сильное — знания; а книга даёт знания.
explanation.en: The most powerful thing is knowledge; and a book gives knowledge.

prompt.uz: Kitob nega kuchli? Toʻgʻri javoblarni bos!
prompt.ru: Почему книга сильна? Нажми верные ответы!
prompt.en: Why is a book powerful? Tap the correct answers!

hint.en: A book gives wisdom and knowledge.

explanation.uz: Kitob bilim beradi, dono qiladi va yaxshilikka oʻrgatadi.
explanation.ru: Книга даёт знания, делает мудрым и учит добру.
explanation.en: A book gives knowledge, makes you wise, and teaches goodness.

prompt.ru: Выбери слово и вставь в пропуск!
prompt.en: Pick a word and fill each gap!

hint.uz: Kitob — bilimning manbai va dononing yaqini.
hint.ru: Книга — источник знаний и друг мудрого.
hint.en: A book is a spring of knowledge and a friend of the wise.

explanation.en: “A book is a spring of knowledge, a friend of the wise.”
